metadata.desc: Tools bili_view and bili_caption read Bilibili video subtitles from a BV ID, av number, video link or short link, so the bot can understand the video or fetch the raw subtitle text

bilibili_cookie.hint: See the README for a detailed guide.

subtitle_language.hint: Language code prefix such as zh, en, ja; within the same language manual subtitles come first, and other subtitles are used when none match

view_max_chars.description: Maximum subtitle characters returned by bili_view per call. 0 means no limit
view_max_chars.hint: Over-limit text keeps the head and tail; the bot can page through the middle with offset

auto_send_txt.description: Whether bili_caption automatically saves subtitles as a txt file and sends it to the chat
auto_send_txt.hint: When enabled, every bili_caption call sends a txt file

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Subtitle cache TTL (seconds). 0 disables the cache
cache_ttl_seconds.hint: Repeated reads of the same video within the TTL hit the cache

cache_max_entries.hint: The least recently used entry is evicted when exceeded
